diffs.diff: formaldehyde_ppb: datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: Winsen ZE08-CH2O manual, active upload frame: 'Start Byte 0XFF | Gas Name CH2O 0X17 | Unit ppb 0x04 | No decimal 0x00 | Concentration (High Byte) | Concentration (Low Byte) | Full Range 0x13 0x88 | Checksum' and 'Gas concentration value=High byte of concentration *256+ Low byte of concentration' -> 1 ppb per count. The model already encodes exactly this: sim.uartStream byte {control:'value', bits:16, scale:1} with unit 'ppb' (FF 17 04 00 CH CL 13 88 SUM), and the driver returns (f[4]<<8)|f[5] as ppb. The gate's authorConversions() only inspects sim.measure/measures/responses/analog ranges, not sim.uartStream, so it reports 'none' although the model's scale is 1 ppb/count, matching the second reading.
